title: Restocking Rates on Crop Protection Product Lately Out of the Plant, Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
Where a member whose season's buying has passed the programme's volume discount threshold brings crop protection product back while the delivery it came off is still lately out of the plant, it is restocked at a lighter rate than the rate the programme carries.

**Clause.** Where the delivery the product came off has stood out of the plant for no more than seven calendar days when the credit is worked out, counted from the date that delivery was invoiced as day zero to the handling date, and the member's input spend on the account over the 10 statement months before the handling date is at or above the programme's volume discount threshold, the restocking rate is 4 percent. Where that delivery has stood out of the plant for more than seven but not more than fourteen calendar days when the credit is worked out, counted the same way, and that spend is at or above the programme's volume discount threshold, the restocking rate is 8 percent. In every other case no lighter restocking rate is granted on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

## Days and spend together

| Calendar days the delivery has stood out of the plant, counted from the date it was invoiced as day zero to the handling date | Input spend over the 10 statement months | Restocking rate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7 or fewer | at or above the programme's threshold | 4 percent |
| more than 7, up to and including 14 | at or above the programme's threshold | 8 percent |
| more than 14 | at or above the programme's threshold | No lighter rate is granted |
| any | below the programme's threshold | No lighter rate is granted |

The count runs from the date the delivery was invoiced, which is day zero, to the handling date on which the credit is worked out, and not to any other day. Day 7 is the last day of the first band and day 14 the last day of the second: a delivery invoiced 7 days before the handling date is restocked at 4 percent, one invoiced 8 days before it at 8 percent, and one invoiced 15 days before it at no lighter rate.

## The threshold the spend is measured against

| Programme | Volume discount threshold (USD) |
| --- | --- |
| Cash Purchase Account | 0 |
| Standard 30-Day Charge Account | 0 |
| Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account | 75000 |
| Early Pay Prepay Program Account | 0 |
| Full Acre Input Financing Account | 150000 |
| Precision Partner Input Program Account | 250000 |
